import sys

def main():
    # Read and skip first line
    sys.stdin.readline()
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip().lower()
    
    # Replace parentheses and underscores with spaces
    import re
    cleaned = re.sub(r'\(.*?\)', ' ', s)
    cleaned = cleaned.replace('_', ' ')
    
    # Split and filter tokens
    tokens = [t for t in cleaned.split() if t]
    
    if not tokens:
        print("0 0", end='')
    else:
        max_length = max(len(t) for t in tokens)
        print(f"{max_length} {len(tokens)}", end='')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
